prompt: Our local café opened again with bright chairs and warm lamps. The main room feels (much / cosy) than before, so people stay longer. The staff also serve drinks (fast) than they used to. We do not wait for coffee any more, and we spend (little / time) in the queue than before.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень «cosier» усиливается словом «much» (y → ier); «faster» — наречие образа действия, а с неисчисляемым «time» используется «less».

prompt: Could we take the early coach instead? The ticket is ___ cheaper than the train.
explanation_ru: Перед сравнительной степенью используют усилители «much» или «far», но не «very» и не второе «more».

prompt: Tariq picked the blue cable because it was longer then his old one.
answer: Tariq picked the blue cable because it was longer than his old one.
accepted_answers: Tariq picked the blue cable because it was longer than his old one.
explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени для сравнения нужен союз «than» (чем), а не «then» (затем).

prompt: Your bag is heavy, and my bag is the same weight. → My bag is as heavy …
answer: My bag is as heavy as yours.
accepted_answers: My bag is as heavy as yours.
My bag is as heavy as your bag.
explanation_ru: Равенство по признаку передаётся парной конструкцией «as + прилагательное + as».

prompt: My uncle asked an engineer to check our cracked garden wall. The report wasn't good news at all. The bricks turned out to be (weak) than the first builder had promised. Repairing the wall will take (long) than we expected, and the whole job costs (much / money) than our original budget allowed.
explanation_ru: Во всех трёх пропусках сравнение идёт с ожиданиями и прежней оценкой через «than»: короткие формы образуют «weaker» и «longer», а «much» меняется на «more».

prompt: Four paths go to the beach. The wooden stairs are firm, well lit and safe; the other three paths are dark and slippery.
options: The wooden stairs are the most dangerous way down to the beach.
The wooden stairs are the least dangerous way down to the beach.
The wooden stairs are as dangerous as the dark rocky paths.
The wooden stairs are more dangerous than the other three paths.
explanation_ru: Раз лестница единственная освещена, она наименее опасная из четырёх путей — «the least dangerous».

prompt: Sofia updated her messaging app after months of ignoring the reminders. With each release, the settings menu seems to grow (hard) and (hard) to follow. On the bright side, the app runs (smoothly) than the old version and freezes (few / times) during video calls. Her sister now recommends it to everyone at college.
explanation_ru: Постепенное усиление передаёт «harder and harder»; наречие на «-ly» образует сравнение через «more smoothly», а с исчисляемым «times» ставится «fewer».

prompt: Let's pack thick jumpers for our autumn trip to the lake. The evenings are getting (cold) and (cold), and people drive (slowly) on the wet mountain roads than in summer. Should we take (many / blankets) than we packed for our beach holiday? I don't want to shiver all night in a tent.
explanation_ru: Нарастание холода выражается парой «colder and colder», способ действия — наречием «more slowly», а большее количество одеял — «more blankets».

prompt: The cheaper water filter works just as effectively than the expensive brand from the department store.
answer: The cheaper water filter works just as effectively as the expensive brand from the department store.
accepted_answers: The cheaper water filter works just as effectively as the expensive brand from the department store.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить «than» вместо второго «as»: правильная парная связка — «as ... as».

prompt: The old gym is half as large as the new sports hall. → The new sports hall is twice …
answer: The new sports hall is twice as large as the old gym.
accepted_answers: The new sports hall is twice as large as the old gym.
The new sports hall is twice as large as the old one.
explanation_ru: Кратное сравнение в английском строится по модели «twice as + прилагательное + as», а не через «twice larger than».

prompt: Five local garages sent us repair estimates for our van's brakes. None of the prices looked good, and even (little / expensive) quote was far above our budget. The workshop on Park Road promised to finish the job (early) than the others, and they check every part (carefully) than the big chain down the road. We ended up borrowing my brother's car for a few days.
explanation_ru: Из пяти вариантов самый недорогой — «the least expensive»; далее два наречия в сравнении через «than»: короткое «earlier» и многосложное «more carefully».

prompt: Kieran reviewed all the customer complaints sitting in his inbox. The broken payment page was clearly (urgent) problem of the whole batch. However, the error log from the server looked only (slightly / clear) than the one he had seen the day before. Could the team handle it (well) than they handled the spring outage?
explanation_ru: Выделение одной проблемы из всех требует «the most urgent», небольшая разница передаётся через «slightly clearer», а наречие «well» имеет исключение «better».

prompt: We compared five office layouts, and Marta's plan beats the other four easily because every desk gets natural light.
options: Marta's plan is slightly more practical than the other four layouts.
Marta's plan is by far the most practical of the five layouts.
Marta's plan is by far the more practical of the five layouts.
Marta's plan is just as practical as the other four layouts.
explanation_ru: Большое превосходство среди пяти вариантов передаётся усилителем «by far» с превосходной степенью «the most practical».

prompt: As the cyclists rode further inland, the hills grew steeper and steeper, and the road became narrower than near the coast.
answer: As the cyclists rode further inland, the hills grew steeper and steeper, and the road became narrower than near the coast.
accepted_answers: As the cyclists rode further inland, the hills grew steeper and steeper, and the road became narrower than near the coast.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: формы «further», двойное сравнение «steeper and steeper» и «narrower than» употреблены правильно.

prompt: When the signs in the station are clearer, passengers make fewer mistakes. → The clearer the signs in the station, …
answer: The clearer the signs in the station, the fewer mistakes passengers make.
accepted_answers: The clearer the signs in the station, the fewer mistakes passengers make.
The clearer the signs in the station, the fewer mistakes the passengers make.
explanation_ru: Зависимость «чем ..., тем ...» строится по схеме «the + сравнительная степень ..., the + сравнительная степень ...», с исчисляемым «mistakes» нужно «fewer».

prompt: Inside the museum shop, Mei examined four simple wooden models of the old bridge. The oak version was (wide) of the whole set, though it still fitted easily on a single palm. Surprisingly, it was (as / detailed / model) as the full-sized carving upstairs, and the artist had painted its arches (neatly) than the gallery's own display copy. Mei bought it for her grandfather's bookshelf without hesitating.
explanation_ru: Из четырёх моделей выделяется «the widest»; перед исчисляемым существительным в ед. ч. используется порядок слов «as detailed a model as»; действие описывает наречие «more neatly».

prompt: Several local groups published reports on cycling safety in our town. The second report was (thorough) of all, even though it was funded by volunteers. Its figures proved just (trustworthy) those in the council's thick booklet, and the authors presented their charts (clearly) than the paid consultants did. Residents quickly shared the summary across neighbourhood forums.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «of all» требует превосходной степени «the most thorough», равенство с «just» — «as trustworthy as», а сравнение способа подачи — «more clearly».

prompt: Although most travellers rely on phone apps, a pocket map remains ___ the digital version when signal disappears.
explanation_ru: В утвердительном предложении с существительным в единственном числе используется порядок «as + прилагательное + a + существительное + as» без «so» и без пропуска артикля.

prompt: Negotiations over our office rent dragged on through the whole autumn. Out of all the proposals on the table, the third landlord's offer was (fair) one we received. Even so, the discount was (not / nearly / generous) our finance manager had hoped, and the new contract gives us (few / parking spaces) than our old building did. Nobody celebrated, yet everyone felt relieved to sign.
explanation_ru: Среди всех предложений выбирается «the fairest»; сильное неравенство выражает «not nearly as generous as», а с исчисляемыми местами нужно «fewer».

prompt: Among the parking rules tested in our district, the permit plan was one of the most unpopular scheme, but far less effective than the previous system.
answer: Among the parking rules tested in our district, the permit plan was one of the most unpopular schemes, but far less effective than the previous system.
accepted_answers: Among the parking rules tested in our district, the permit plan was one of the most unpopular schemes, but far less effective than the previous system.
explanation_ru: После конструкции «one of the + превосходная степень» существительное всегда стоит во множественном числе: «schemes», а не «scheme».

prompt: Whenever a booking form gets confusing, customers take longer to finish their order. → The more confusing a booking form gets, …
answer: The more confusing a booking form gets, the longer customers take to finish their order.
accepted_answers: The more confusing a booking form gets, the longer customers take to finish their order.
explanation_ru: Во второй части конструкции «the ..., the ...» сравнительная степень наречия «the longer» выносится на первое место перед подлежащим.
